items.question: By what count and in what setting are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified for the setting.
That count applies to thousands of womb-diagrams.
Beings are stated to be tormented within those settings.
items.inference: Beings are tormented in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings is not specified by these tokens alone.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places in which beings are tormented.
